featureIntro: Combine selected field I/O and instrument connections with edge processing, configurable control modes, Modbus TCP integration and online monitoring.
interfaceHeading:
Connect the equipment.

interfaceIntro: Select the fitted field I/O and serial connections for the equipment. Modbus TCP is a protocol for data exchange; its network path, working roles and data map are specified separately from the physical interface.
workflowIntro: Give each field point a clear meaning, define the permitted action and verify equipment feedback. Local controls, interlocks and independent protection remain part of the installation.
imageNote: Representative environments. External instruments, fitted interfaces and permitted control actions follow the selected installation.

modelNote: HD20-1000 series. Select the DO, DI and AI allocation, instrument connections and Modbus TCP operating scope for the ordered version.
downloadNote: English datasheet. Request the electrical and connection schedule for your selected configuration.
scopeNote: Match instruments, equipment-state signals and command circuits to the supplied electrical specification. Keep equipment sequencing, interlocks and required independent protection in place.
faqIntro: Answers for I/O selection, serial and Modbus TCP integration, control permissions, cloud access and remote maintenance.
